name: git-workflow
description: A repository workflow toolkit for pull request and issue triage, review, execution loops, and a local review desk.

interface.shortDescription: Drain pull request and issue queues safely.
interface.longDescription: Triage pull requests and issues, verify review state, work approved changes, and use a local dashboard backed by deterministic provider reads.
defaultPrompt: Use $pr-triage to show what needs my attention.
Use $review-desk to open both repository desks.
